Focus on your core business while we manage your IT infrastructure. Our managed services provide 24/7 monitoring, proactive maintenance, helpdesk support, and strategic guidance to keep your technology running at peak performance.

Capabilities

What We Deliver

01

24/7 Monitoring

Continuous monitoring of servers, networks, applications, and endpoints. Proactive alerting and automated remediation to prevent issues before they impact your business.

02

Managed IT Support

Dedicated support with guaranteed response times. Tier 1-3 support for all technology issues with escalation procedures and SLA tracking.

03

Patch Management

Automated patch management for operating systems, applications, and firmware. Ensure security compliance and reduce vulnerability exposure.

04

Backup & Recovery

Comprehensive backup solutions with regular testing and verified recovery procedures. Protect your data with 3-2-1 backup strategies and immutable backups.

05

Endpoint Management

Unified endpoint management for desktops, laptops, and mobile devices. Deploy, configure, and secure all endpoints from a central console.

06

Network Management

Enterprise network management including switches, routers, firewalls, and wireless infrastructure. Performance optimization and capacity planning.

Success Stories

Real-World Results

1

Full IT Outsourcing

Law firm with 500 employees outsourced entire IT operations, reducing IT costs by 30% while improving user satisfaction scores by 45%.

2

Co-Managed IT

Manufacturing company augmented internal IT team with managed services, extending coverage to 24/7 and reducing after-hours incidents by 80%.

3

Remote Workforce

Professional services firm deployed and managed IT infrastructure for 2,000 remote workers in 30 days, maintaining security and productivity.

Frequently Asked Questions

What's the minimum number of users?

Minimum is 10 users. For smaller teams, contact our sales team for custom pricing.

Can I change plans mid-year?

Yes, you can upgrade or downgrade anytime. Changes take effect the next billing cycle.

Do you offer onboarding support?

Yes, onboarding is $50/user (waived for 25+ seats). We handle full setup and training.

What's your SLA?

Essential: 4-hour response. Professional: 15-minute response. Elite: 15-minute response with dedicated support.
